scope: Literal EP0 event replay through pinned C USB/WebUSB and Rust production USB/WebUSB facade, with real applets. No physical USB, cross-transport concurrency or CIU resource acceptance inferred.

cases.preconditions: Fresh authenticator storage; configured USB; real EP0 setup/data/status stages,16-byte control packets and serialized main-loop polls.
